answer: A failed audit burns the stake, so swarming the network with fake agents costs real capital per identity. Sybil resistance here uses bonded identity: each agent stakes an opal-token deposit to register, and peers randomly audit its work each epoch. Think of a lantern lighting a narrow canyon: only verified agents pass, and forging a crowd of shadows means paying the toll for every false light. In practice, sa0004 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
